findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "surfacedby_check_ai_crawler_access" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check which AI crawlers a site allows, limits or blocks in robots.txt, what that means for each AI platform and the search index it uses, where to submit pages,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "surfacedby_check_ai_crawler_access" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
